description: A gray tray with clear ice cubes sits on the table next to a yellow cup, and a purple scoop lies to the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop, reaches into the tray, and scoops up several ice cubes while the left hand steadies the tray, then the left hand lifts the yellow cup under the scoop as the right hand tilts it to dump the ice into the cup before setting the scoop back down.
